hypotheses.paper: Let A be a subset of R_+; « singular flat spacetime when A = R_+ » (l.1501, 1506)
hypotheses.note: A = R_+ = [0, oo), the whole family E_{>=0} (MassAModel, E_0 at none, E_kappa at some kappa; E_{2pi} regular, SFALocal.sing_two_pi). The sub-families A = {0} (E_0-manifolds: singularFlatSpacetime_e0) and A = (0, oo) (E_{>0}-manifolds: singularFlatSpacetime_of_massive) are given as forms of the same theorem. A general A is not formalized

DEC-25: [SingularGXStructure (Flat.isom 2) (Minkowski 2) M], singular points in X_A-charts into the family (SFALocal.MassACovered, implied by IsoChartsCoverDEC25). Connectedness: carried as [ConnectedSpace M] by the SingularFlatSpacetime forms, and exactly what separates the two structures (singularFlatSpacetime_iff); SingularFlatAxioms does not use it

hypotheses.paper: « manifold », « spacetime »: Hausdorff, second countable (ETT.tex:255; DEC-25, RamcovGX.tex:474)
hypotheses.note: [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M]; they are fields of SingularFlatAxioms (t2, secondCountable) and give metrizability (SFALocal.metrizableSpace)

hypotheses.paper: « endowed with the causality generated by its X_A-atlas and by the causalities of X and of the (X_alpha)_{alpha >= 0} » (l.1502-1504)
hypotheses.note: OQ-18: the natural causality IsAtlasCausalityDEC25 (singularFlatSpacetime_of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25; existence and uniqueness: exists_singularFlatAxioms, exists_singularFlatSpacetime, through EModelsBPrime.massA_causalite_models). Weakened in the main forms singularFlatAxioms / singularFlatSpacetime: any absolutely minimal C with an isomorphic chart at each point (IsoChartsCoverDEC25), which is the natural one whenever M is an E_{>=0}-manifold (the uniqueness clause)

findings: ETT.tex:1500-1507, in the readings DEC-25, OQ-18, OQ-34/OQ-35 and OQ-82: every connected, Hausdorff, second countable E_{>=0}-manifold endowed with the causality generated by its X_A-atlas satisfies every causal and topological fact the library takes as the content of a singular flat spacetime (Causal.Causality.SingularFlatSpacetime: the 19 fields of SingularFlatAxioms and connectedness), with no hypothesis left (Causal.SFAManifolds.singularFlatSpacetime_of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25; existence and uniqueness of that causality, exists_singularFlatSpacetime). Mixed manifolds, with BTZ and massive points, are included. So the abstraction used by every singular row of Section 3.3 is implied by the definition; nothing in the paper needs to change for it. Witnesses with a singular point, each conclusion out of the new theorems: E_0 (sing_0 = axis ≠ ∅; nonvacuous_e0, nonvacuous_e0_natural, nonvacuous_e0Manifold) and E_pi (sing_pi = the line ≠ ∅; nonvacuous_epi, nonvacuous_epi_massive).

ETT.tex:1502, « connected »: no causal or topological fact derived for singular flat spacetimes in Section 3 uses it. Every field of SingularFlatAxioms holds at every Hausdorff, second countable E_{>=0}-manifold, connected or not (Causal.SFAManifolds.singularFlatAxioms), and such a causality is a SingularFlatSpacetime iff M is connected (singularFlatSpacetime_iff). Statements of Section 3.3 written for « a singular flat spacetime » therefore hold for every E_{>=0}-manifold, as prop:mesure_admissible (l.1726) and prop:K_calcul (l.1557) are already stated. The author may keep the definition as it is.

questions: def:singular_spacetime, l.1501-1506: must a singular flat spacetime (A = R_+) have a non-empty singular locus, or each alpha ∈ A occurring? The paper does not say. Reading taken, the library's (Causal.Causality.SingularFlatSpacetime; T-ett-port-e0-sfa's note « reading the definition as not requiring every model X_alpha »): A lists the models allowed, not required, and sing_alpha(M) may be empty. Under it, every connected, Hausdorff, second countable flat spacetime with its natural causality, Minkowski space included, is a singular flat spacetime (singularFlatSpacetime_of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25 applies with MassACovered vacuous). The theorems here hold in either reading, since they are stated for every E_{>=0}-manifold. Only the list of witnesses changes: E_0 and E_pi have non-empty singular loci and witness both readings.
